rows.whatChanged: Two changes, in one function, in one file. (1) THE TRAILER PULL-DOWN. renderComposedPdf laid rows out one at a time and started a new page when y fell below the margin, which is 45 rows a page. It now settles that same layout as a plan first -- each row tagged with the source line it came from and whether that line is the route trailer, filling pages in exactly the order and at exactly the density it always did -- and then applies the sole-occupant pull-down: a LAST page whose every drawn row is trailer takes the PREVIOUS block down onto it. Whole blocks only, a move that would not fit is refused, and a page that already carries prose is left alone. This is scripts/build-census-v1-rcap-ok-custom-pleading.mjs's rule as FIX35 carried it to Rhode Island, moved onto this builder's own pagination rather than a new scheme; rowsPerPage is derived from the geometry this composer already had (floor((792 - 144) / 14.5) + 1 = 45), so with the pull-down inert the pagination is row-for-row what it was. An assertion now proves it rather than intending it: no page of a composed document may be trailer-only. (2) THE SPLITTER. The private character-accumulating splitToken is deleted and replaced by createTokenSplitter({ fits: fitsByFontMetrics(font, fontSize, maxWidth) }) from scripts/rcap-custom-pleading/split-token.mjs, with assert.equal(splitToken.hardSplits, 0, ...) after every composed document. This family shipped no hard split, so the splitter change moves no ink here; it removes the last private copy from this builder and makes a future separatorless key fail the build. Not changed: no wrap rule, no line height, no column width, no component, no field map, no source pin, no route key, no appearance-registry entry, not one character of the decretal block, no court term and no instruction line. WHAT THIS FAMILY SHIPPED BEFORE, READ OFF THE DELIVERED BYTES: page 5 of ten, inside the proposed order the court is asked to sign, carried exactly one line of ink -- "Route: obligation:track-pathway:MS:ms-fel:eligible-felony-conviction-expungement-99-19-71" -- and nothing else. AFTER: page 5 opens on the parenthetical that closes the order, "(The findings, the date of entry, the judge's signature and the prosecuting authority's approval as to form are all left blank. They are not the participant's to complete.)", with the trailer beneath it. Page 4 keeps the whole decretal block, the SO ORDERED AND ADJUDGED line, the JUDGE rule and the APPROVED AS TO FORM rule, character for character; only that closing parenthetical block moved down.
